seed: Writing a five minute Retina recording out at 1080p, at Next defaults with no flag touched, the way the Export sheet's button does: the toast comes up and fills while the window stays free to use, and the file lands in well under half the time the five minutes run.

steps.note: Five minutes of a Retina recording took nearly six minutes to write at 1080p, longer than it plays. Premiere writes a screen recording several times faster than it plays. This walk starts that export the way the sheet does and watches the toast and the window while it writes

The toast is up at the foot of the canvas, saying what it writes and how far along it is, and starting it never held the window: no pass over 50 ms. It used to be a sheet, and a sheet's slide held the window for about 300 ms
The window is still yours while it writes: L plays, K stops, the way they always do
